causalDisposition.fact: Codex 0.147.0 accepted the per-process apps._default.enabled=false override and reported no installed or callable App and no MCP server in the isolated no-plugin process. Isolating CODEX_HOME did not isolate Skill discovery: 33 shared CC Switch Skills and six Codex system Skills remained enabled.
causalDisposition.inference: The stable per-process App switch is a usable part of a future dispatch preflight, and CC Switch is not a Harness dependency. It is a replaceable ambient discovery source whose Skills must be treated like every other non-task capability. The global no-thread status responses do not prove whether list_mcp_resources is absent from a future model-visible tool specification, whether an empty enumeration result is guaranteed after the Harness plugin is loaded, or whether the same bounded process preserves every required model-driven repository operation.
causalDisposition.routeDisposition: The exact current Codex measured route remains ineligible for another outcome task. A future registration may use apps._default.enabled=false only together with a post-load exact Skill inventory and task-scoped exclusion of every non-Harness Skill, plus an independent pre-model proof of the thread-specific model-visible MCP/App resource surface and required repository tools. If the stable host always exposes a harmless enumeration primitive, bind zero unauthorized resources and zero unauthorized invocation or effect rather than manufacturing an impossible tool-absence floor.
causalDisposition.productBoundary: Do not add an MCP manager, App gateway, capability registry, runtime, control plane, CC Switch dependency, persistent deny list, or generic outcome validator. This is parent-dispatch evidence only.
